product_one_liner.value: SiMa.ai provides a purpose-built edge-AI platform combining MLSoC hardware with Palette software so teams can build and run Physical AI applications on devices across robotics, automotive, industrial automation, and other industries.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its platform as software-centric and designed for Physical AI at the edge.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer provide product, developer, and contact links but no public pricing page; pricing is not displayed.

named_customers.notes: The closest company pages and the cited coverage list organizations under combined “Customer and Partner Stories” or “customer and partner” wording, without identifying which individual organizations are customers rather than partners. I have therefore not attributed any organization as a customer.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: SiMa.ai identifies San Jose, California as its headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The company profile states it was founded in 2018.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index includes multiple engineering posts. Examples include an MLSoC engineering deep dive authored by the VP of Hardware Engineering and technical implementation/framework posts authored by the Associate VP of MLA Software.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation and developer center contain multiple product, hardware, software, API, and model-development articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A live posting is titled “Principal Engineer, AI & ML Design Verification.”

model_provider.value: SiMa.ai publicly documents support for Meta Llama, Google Gemma, Microsoft Phi, Qwen, Mistral, and other model families; the documentation does not indicate that the product is limited to a single provider.
model_provider.notes: The documented supported-model list includes architectures associated with the named providers. This is evidence of supported models, not a claim that SiMa.ai itself trains or uses only those providers’ models.

compliance_certs.notes: The checked privacy and quality-policy pages do not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS certifications.

last_funding.notes: The company announced a $150 million Series C on September 28, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 2026 Series C falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers and job-board pages show open roles, but the listed roles checked were not SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive positions.

launched_6mo.notes: SiMa.ai announced the Palette Neat product launch on June 16, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small management-team page was checked in full and lists no C-level or VP-level join dates within the window; the checked newsroom did not show an announcement of a C-level or VP-level departure.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The public developer documentation and job-board pages checked did not name a CRM or sales/marketing system.
